member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Devices.Signals.DigitalSignal.Capture(System.UInt32,GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Devices.Gpio.GpioPinEdge,System.Boolean,System.TimeSpan)
member.summary: Capture timestamps of `count` edges on the pin.
member.remarks: The returned buffer holds inter-edge intervals in nanoseconds: - When is true the timer starts on the first edge, so buffer[0] is the interval between the first and second edges, buffer[i] the interval from edge i+1 to edge i+2, and the returned length is count - 1. - When is false the timer starts immediately. buffer[0] is the time from timer-start to the first edge (and includes ~150 ns of counter-vs-DMA startup latency); for high-frequency signals discard buffer[0].
